name: pathfinder
description: PathFinder: minimum-cost grid path DP, data-parallel over columns, sequential over rows.

output_parser.comment: Each line is '<index>\t<value>'; integer accumulated path costs of the final row, compared exactly.

tolerance.comment: Integer min/add DP — exact match required, no float reordering.

build.comment: Integer math; no FMA concerns, so correctness and perf builds are identical.
